scope: Read-only audit of provenance available for the frozen SecureBERT checkpoint; no sealed data, training, or model mutation.
checked_local_sources: data/models/ (repository model paths checked for a separate SecureBERT training receipt)
evaluation/ and configs/ (local manifests checked for a SecureBERT dataset-membership receipt)
available_training_provenance: Checkpoint/model/tokenizer/label-mapping bytes and their content hashes.
Classifier environment identity, current rule policy, ATT&CK cache, authority/trust source hashes, and candidate/trusted score cutoffs.
A bundle source_receipt containing temporary source-root paths; it does not identify a training corpus.
missing_training_provenance: Authoritative training corpus/archive identity and immutable membership list.
Train/validation/test split membership and leakage/intersection receipt.
Per-example label-generation policy version, source evidence, confidence, and rule/model provenance.
Training run configuration beyond the checkpoint artifact (seed, optimizer, schedule, preprocessing and dependency receipt).
Independent dataset-level evaluation receipt tied to the exact checkpoint and label domain.
conclusion: The checkpoint has strong byte/model identity but incomplete training-data provenance. It must not be represented as independently reproducible or as canonical ATT&CK truth until the missing dataset and label-lineage evidence is supplied.
